Welcome to Omnibus, and thank you for your first pull request.

Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/schultz-evogenome/omnibus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) if you have not. The check on this pull request validates manifests, resolves ORCIDs and DOIs, probes endpoints and checks commons licenses; its log says exactly what it looked at.

When the check is green, a core member will review and merge. If you would like to join the core team after contributing, say so here.
